_doc: Do-not-repeat memory. Machine-readable index of every mechanism already falsified, with the evidence and вЂ” critically вЂ” the REVIVAL CONDITION that would make it worth re-testing. This is not a blacklist: it is a cost filter. The ideator MUST read it before proposing, and any proposal sharing an axis with an entry here MUST name the revival condition it satisfies.

meta_rules.rule: SCOPED 2026-08-26 to the SYMMETRIC family. The old wording said 'the continuous/gradient family is exhausted' and that 'at Rocket's operating scale the better order is NOT preferred by the surrogate at ANY beta in [0.05, 1.05]'. Both clauses are FALSE outside odd-symmetric shapes g(-z)=1-g(z), and the counterexample was logged on 2026-08-17: H38's one-sided surrogate scores +0.36675 pp pure Rocket on connectome (3/3 seeds, 30.6x the minimum effect size), and Q05 measures its alignment at +1.48..+2.00 with NO crossover in beta*std over [1e-2,1e6]. THE RULE NOW READS: within the odd-symmetric family the continuous axis is exhausted, and any symmetric-shape hypothesis must explain how it escapes Q01's scale-blindness. An ASYMMETRIC objective is NOT covered: it does not telescope into the imbalance objective (its first-order term runs over the order-dependent VIOLATED subset), so Q01's collapse argument does not reach it. Such a hypothesis must still (a) pass src/mfas/analysis/surrogate_gate.py, (b) show no crossover in beta*std, and (c) be measured COMPOSED with the champion stack, not against pure Rocket -- because the one thing Q01 does not settle is whether a better pure order survives composition, and the measured pure->final transfer coefficient is 10-28% and turns NEGATIVE past the operating point (proto_S01_connectome.json). Fifteen shapes have been measured inside the symmetry assumption and exactly two outside it, both positive on the primary (H38 +0.36675, H38B +0.14416). ---- AMENDED 2026-08-27 (cycle 16, H64). THE OPEN CLAUSE IS NOW CLOSED, AND THE ANSWER IS AFFIRMATIVE. This rule required an asymmetric hypothesis to (a) pass surrogate_gate.py, (b) show no crossover in beta*std, and (c) be measured COMPOSED with the champion stack, 'because the one thing Q01 does not settle is whether a better pure order survives composition'. H64 did all three. It DOES survive: connectome pure 82.92969571752491 -> 83.23791666953974 (+0.308221 pp, i.e. 84% of H38's MPS random-init figure SURVIVES the greedy-FAS warm start, so the basin objection is answered too), and composed 84.15409511053134 -> 84.25817950936937 (+0.104084 pp, 8.67x the bar, 5/5 bit-identical seeds, at a LOWER wall clock). The measured pure->final transfer coefficient is 33.8%, ABOVE proto_S01's 10.3-28.0% band. So the sentence 'the measured pure->final transfer coefficient is 10-28% and turns NEGATIVE past the operating point' is not a bound on what a shape gain can deliver - it was measured by varying EPOCHS along one pipeline, and a shape change transfers better than an epoch change does. Requirements (a), (b) and (c) all STAND for any future asymmetric proposal. What is retired is the presumption that (c) would fail. H64 was NOT promoted, for reasons that have nothing to do with the mechanism (a missing relabelling study and a microns runtime failure that also affects the champion) - see experiments/log.md 2026-08-27 Cycle 16.
meta_rules.evidence: diagnosis.md Q01 (symmetric family) and Q04 section 4 ('the broader claim no shape can help is FALSE'); Q05 + experiments/log.md 2026-08-17 (H38, the counterexample); proto_S01_connectome.json (the transfer curve). NOTE: findings.md #3, cited as this rule's evidence until 2026-08-26, carries a retraction banner dated 2026-08-17 stating that its universal quantifier does not stand.

meta_rules.rule: AMENDED 2026-08-26, sentence 2 only. Sentence 1 STANDS and is reinforced: interventions on optimization DYNAMICS (optimizer, LR, beta schedule, clipping, EMA, restarts, gradient noise) re-converge to the plateau -- H38's own control H38D (plain sigmoid at beta x 4 for a whole run, -0.58043 pp) is a stronger scale control than the one that killed H03, and it loses. Sentence 2 said 'only the starting BASIN (H02) and DISCRETE refinement (H30/H35) ever moved the metric'. That is FALSE: against the same baseline_passthrough pool H02 is +0.03496 pp and H38 is +0.36675 pp, i.e. the objective SHAPE moved the metric 10.5x more than one of the two levers this rule named as the only ones that work. The correct reading is: dynamics are null; the objective's SHAPE is not, but only outside the symmetric family (see M1). Whether a shape gain survives composition with the refinement stack is OPEN and is what H64 measures. ---- AMENDED 2026-08-27 (cycle 16, H64). This rule ended 'Whether a shape gain survives composition with the refinement stack is OPEN and is what H64 measures.' It is no longer open: it survives, at a 33.8% transfer coefficient, +0.104084 pp on the composed connectome score. Sentence 1 (dynamics are null) still STANDS and nothing in H64 touches the optimizer, LR, beta schedule, clipping, EMA, restarts or gradient noise. The corrected reading is now complete: DYNAMICS are null; the objective's SHAPE is not, only outside the symmetric family, AND its gain composes.

meta_rules.rule: Plain Rocket has no seed-to-seed score dispersion to harvest (connectome 82.8845 +/- 0.0225 pp) even though orderings differ (Spearman 0.958). Any best-of-K / multi-start / sampling idea must first show it CREATES score dispersion, or it harvests nothing.

A move class's own stage credit is NOT its contribution, and a prototype showing that a class 'works' is NOT a screen. Move classes inside an alternating refiner compete for the same ground. MEASURED 2026-08-16: H41's segment class was credited +0.07010 pp on connectome while delivering +0.00570 pp net, because adding it cut the two existing classes' joint credit from 0.24058 to 0.17618 - 91.9% of what it found was already reachable. Judge a new move class ONLY by the composed champion-vs-variant delta at constant-for-constant matched settings, and REPORT THE REDUNDANCY FRACTION (old classes' credit before minus after, over the new class's credit). A class must also clear the marginal rate of the stage it is inserted into (stage 4 measured at 3.45e-4 pp/s on connectome, 4.33e-4 on microns), not merely be non-zero.

NARROWED 2026-08-16 - read the amendment before citing this rule. PROVEN: bounded-window single-node local search is empty for W <= 100 (leakage-safe reachable pool at W=100 is 0.0270 pp of a 0.4606 pp remaining gap; H30's W=10 arm measured ~0). DIRECTIVE, still in force: prefer global-range or structurally decomposed (SCC / block) move classes. NOT PROVEN, and formerly asserted here as if it were: that windows ABOVE 100 are empty. The headline figures this rule used to quote (W=100 -0.010 pp, W=1000 -0.170, W=5000 -0.405) are measure2_gap_flip_distance.net_pp = gain(W) - lose(W) from experiments/size_localsearch.py. That statistic measures how much of the REFERENCE ordering's own rearrangement is short-range - a property of the reference, not a bound on local search. A hill-climb never pays the `lose` term, it declines those moves, so a negative net_pp does not imply nothing is recoverable. The leakage-safe CEILING in the same artifact (measure1_reachable_pool) puts the reachable feedback pool at 0.4141 pp for W=1000 and 2.3225 pp for W=5000, so CAPACITY IS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT above W=100. A ceiling is not an achievable amount - flipping window edges creates new feedback. Do not cite Vahidi 2025 either way: that method is uncapped/global-range, not bounded-span (autoresearch/lit/vahidi-2025.md).
meta_rules.evidence: experiments/outputs/localsearch_sizing.json (BOTH measures: measure1 is the ceiling, measure2 is the reference's structure); H22 kill (but see its amended record); H30's W=10 arm ~0; autoresearch/lit/vahidi-2025.md

meta_rules.rule: The continuous optimizer leaves 0 exact position ties and negligible near-ties (0.03% vs a 1.69 pp gap). Nothing is recoverable from tie-breaking or strict-'>' handling. Permanently closed.

The init -> plateau curve is flat on connectome (82.87-82.93% across inits spanning 36-69% quality). Better-init-alone has a <=0.06 pp ceiling; H02 already took it. Init ideas only matter in combination with a mechanism that can HOLD the better basin.

Among discrete starting orders for the sift, cheap greedy-FAS is at least as good as expensive global linear-algebra embeddings. Trophic and magnetic-Laplacian warm-starts were both WORSE seeds, and the spectral one cost 304-507 s. Do not buy an expensive warm-start.

QUANTITATIVE form of M3, and it supersedes M3's existential test. Dispersion existing is not enough: best-of-R over R draws gains sigma * a_R over the mean (a_R = E[max of R standard normals]: a_2 = 0.5642, a_3 = 0.8463, a_4 = 1.0294), and R is NOT a free parameter - it is floor(runtime guard deadline / per-run wall clock). So a multi-start idea must show sigma >= min_promotion_delta_pp / a_R_feasible BEFORE it is built. On connectome at the champion's 1152.0 s/run the deadline allows R = 2, so the required sigma is 0.012 / 0.5641896 = 0.021269 pp. MEASURED relabelling sigma is 0.019124 pp - a 10% shortfall with no room to buy it back with R. Two corollaries. (1) The comparator is the CANONICAL score sota.json records, not the labelling mean; when canonical sits above the mean (here z = +1.029) best-of-R over RANDOM draws is a REGRESSION and only a canonical-anchored design is even monotone. (2) The matched-compute control is the measured saturation curve, not an assumption: doubling refinement seconds at ONE labelling buys +0.006275 pp against best-of-2's +0.000351 pp, i.e. ~18x more for the same clock. CAVEAT the rule carries with it: sigma is usually estimated from few points, and the chi-squared interval at n = 5 spans a factor of ~4.8 (here [0.011458, 0.054955] pp). Apply M9 to the point estimate to decide whether to BUILD, but do not call a kill secure on this ground alone unless the interval's relevant bound also clears - say which you used.

The relabelling nuisance of this pipeline is created almost entirely in the SHARED PREFIX (greedy-FAS tie-breaks -> Rocket), not in the refinement tail. MEASURED on connectome: whole-pipeline sigma 0.019124 pp (n = 5, proto_P09_connectome.json) vs TAIL-ONLY sigma 0.003731 pp from one fixed prefix (n = 8, proto_H57_connectome.json) - i.e. the tail holds ~4% of the variance and the prefix ~96%. CONSEQUENCE, and it is why this rule exists rather than being folded into M9: sharing the prefix to buy a bigger R is self-defeating. It multiplies R by about 2 (connectome R = 2 -> 4) while dividing sigma by about 5 (ratio 0.003731/0.019124 = 0.195), and a_R grows far too slowly to compensate - a_4/a_2 is only 1.82. So ANY design of the form 'pay the expensive prefix once, randomise the cheap tail R times' is dead on arithmetic before it is built, whatever the tail is. STRONGEST FORM OF THE EVIDENCE: over the nine measured arms the canonical labelling is the MAXIMUM, so the canonical-anchored best-of-R gains exactly 0.000000 pp at every R, by enumeration rather than by estimate. Together with M9 this closes the multi-start family: the only surviving door is a mechanism that WIDENS sigma at the champion's per-arm cost, and it has to widen the PREFIX's sigma, because that is where the dispersion is.

THE BINDING CONSTRAINT ON THIS CAMPAIGN IS ACHIEVABILITY, NOT CAPACITY - and the gap between them is about two orders of magnitude. M4's amendment asserted this in words ('a ceiling is not an achievable amount - flipping window edges creates new feedback'); H47 measured both numbers on the SAME order at the SAME scale for the first time. On the champion's connectome order, the weight of backward edges confined inside 16-node contiguous windows is +0.479839 pp - MORE than the entire remaining 0.4606 pp gap to the reference - yet the EXACT optimum over all k! orderings of those windows realises +0.004342 pp, which is 0.90% of it. microns 4.59%, mouse 1.95%. CONSEQUENCE, and this is the operative half: a 'reachable pool' / 'ceiling' / 'confined weight' statistic is NOT evidence that a move class will pay, and must never again be quoted as the justification for building one. It bounds the family from above and nothing more. The only admissible evidence is a realised gain from an exact or run optimum. Quote a ceiling only alongside its realisation ratio, and if the ratio is unmeasured, say so.
evidence: killed.json M4 amendment, which stated this without measuring it
meta_rules.scope: Measured at k <= 16 on all three datasets. The ceiling itself keeps rising with k on connectome (+0.614244 pp at k=32, +0.865799 at k=128, +1.439876 at k=1024) while H46 measured the achievable gain at 17,081-68,324 nodes as exactly 0.000000 pp, so the divergence between the two curves is documented at both ends of the scale range, not just at the micro end.

meta_rules.rule: A COMPOSED PROTOTYPE RUN FROM THE CHAMPION'S OWN CONVERGED ORDER SYSTEMATICALLY OVERSTATES a pipeline change, because the control arm starts at (or near) its own fixed point and the variant arm does not. The variant harvests ground the real pipeline's control ALSO harvests - earlier in its own trajectory, where a from-champion control can no longer re-take it. So `champion order + N cycles of X` minus `champion order + N cycles of Y` is NOT an estimator of `full pipeline with X` minus `full pipeline with Y`. MEASURED on H60, prototype vs screen on the same mechanism: connectome +0.027477 -> +0.007311 pp (3.76x overstatement), microns +0.003448 -> +0.002967 (1.16x), mouse +0.085531 -> EXACTLY +0.000000 (the control arm there had 0.000000 pp left, and the full pipeline gained nothing at all). SECOND HALF, and it is why this is a rule and not an erratum: the prototype rung is biased in BOTH directions depending on where it starts. A standalone refiner measured from scratch UNDER-states (H36: one-shot condensation +0.00013 pp -> +0.1837 pp alternated); a composed variant measured from the champion's converged order OVER-states. The only unbiased measurement of a pipeline change is the pipeline. OPERATIVE CONSEQUENCE: a composed-from-champion prototype number is a SCREENING number - fine for deciding whether to spend GPU, never quotable as the expected screen result, and never as evidence in a promotion argument. Quote it with its control arm's own remaining headroom beside it, which is what makes the bias visible.
meta_rules.amended_2026_08_26_cycle14: SCOPE NARROWED, by measurement. M12's bias requires the variant to DIVERGE from the control somewhere upstream - that is what leaves the control at its own fixed point while the variant arm is not. It therefore applies to a variant that changes an INNER stage (H60: prototype +0.027477 -> screen +0.007311, 3.76x) and NOT to one that only APPENDS a terminal stage. H59 measured the boundary: prototype +0.017596 pp, screen +0.017658 pp, difference +0.000062 pp (0.35% relative), because H59's stage 1-4 output is bit-identical to the champion's (h42_best_pct = 84.15409511053134 inside the H59 run) so the variant arm's input IS the control arm's output. READ M12 AS: a from-champion prototype is a biased SCREENING number for any change other than the last stage, and a genuine PREDICTION for a pure append. Evidence: results/*-H59-connectome-s42-implement-*.json, experiments/outputs/proto_H59_connectome.json, experiments/log.md 2026-08-26 (Cycle 14).

killed.mechanism: ratio-greedy init (out_w+1)/(in_w+1) replacing greedy-FAS, as a drop-in warm start
killed.verdict: screen FAIL 2026-08-16 (variant H49) - fails connectome and fails mouse non-inferiority
killed.why_dead: The init was measured +5.70387 pp better than ours (74.61730 vs 68.91343 on connectome, both on the frozen scorer, independently reproducing the reference family's Algorithm 1 claim). After stage 3 it was still +0.03456 pp ahead. After the FULL pipeline it was -0.01382 pp behind. The advantage did not wash out, it INVERTED. This is the third measured instance in 24 h of the refinement stack being non-monotone in the quality of its input, and it settles where the reference family's margin lives: NOT in the initial order.
killed.revival_if: Only paired with the refiner it was designed for (iterated exact-gain pair relocation - see H45's revival condition), measured as a whole pipeline against the champion. Never again as a drop-in warm start for the current stack.

killed.mechanism: exact-gain bounded-span SEGMENT moves (rigid contiguous-block relocation) as a third class inside stage 4
killed.verdict: screen FAIL on both primaries (2026-08-16) - below screen_delta_pp 0.012 / 0.002
killed.why_dead: NOT emptiness - REDUNDANCY. The class fired 4,619 times on connectome (M4 and the handoff both predicted ZERO) and was credited +0.07010 pp, but adding it cut the other two classes' joint credit from 0.24058 to 0.17618, i.e. 91.9% of its ground was already reachable by single-node insertion + SCC block refinement. Net advantage +0.00570 pp. It also loses on allocation: 126.6 s for that net = 4.50e-5 pp/s against stage 4's measured 3.45e-4 pp/s. Implementation is correct and exact (145,386 (segment,target) pairs cross-checked against the frozen scorer with zero mismatches); the mechanism simply overlaps what is already there.
killed.revival_if: The redundancy is broken, not the ladder lengthened. A longer ladder alone is NOT a revival condition - the default ladder already fires 4,619 times and 91.9% of that is redundant, so more rungs plausibly buy more redundancy. Revive only if (a) the class is run where the others cannot reach - e.g. as the ONLY refiner from a different starting basin - or (b) an interleaving is found that stops the classes competing for the same ground, with the redundancy fraction reported. Any revival must report redundancy per M8.

killed.verdict: killed at the sizing gate (before building)
killed.why_dead: AMENDED 2026-08-16. Originally: 'See M4 - the recoverable weight is long-range.' That kill was taken AT THE SIZING GATE, BEFORE BUILDING, on measure2's net_pp - the statistic M4 has now been narrowed for misreading, because it describes the reference ordering rather than the reach of a hill-climb. By the leakage-safe ceiling in the same artifact a W=1000 window holds 0.4141 pp of reachable feedback against a 0.4606 pp remaining gap. This hypothesis was therefore never falsified by measurement; it was declined on a misread bound and never run.
killed.revival_if: EITHER (a) the window is replaced by a STRUCTURAL neighbourhood (SCC / block) rather than a rank window - that is H36, already shipped and confirmed; OR (b) NEW 2026-08-16: it is simply run, because the original evidentiary basis for declining it does not support the conclusion. Any revival must beat the CURRENT champion (connectome 84.1541), not the H30-era baseline this was filed against, and must justify its wall-clock against the measured stage-4 marginal rate of 3.45e-4 pp/s (experiments/log.md 2026-08-16) - a move class that is merely non-empty is not automatically worth its seconds.

killed.why_dead: The decisive falsifier for M1: the gradient is genuinely non-vanishing (398/400 nodes move) and it STILL loses to the plain sigmoid. The bottleneck is the relaxation basin, not the gradient estimator.

killed.mechanism: best-of-R over R randomly RELABELLED copies of the graph (relabelling is an exact isomorphism, so it perturbs only tie-breaks), full champion pipeline per arm
killed.verdict: killed by prototype gate - FALSIFIED on three independent grounds
killed.why_dead: The premise was right and the arithmetic still kills it. (1) RUNTIME: the guard deadline allows R = 2 on connectome (1152.0 s/run against 3450 s) and R = 1 on microns (3418 s/run), so the variant is the champion on a primary by construction and can never pass a screen that requires a delta on BOTH primaries. (2) EFFECT SIZE: at R = 2 the strongest (canonical-anchored, monotone) design gains +0.000351 pp measured / +0.001507 pp modelled against a 0.012 pp bar; the R that would clear the bar is 13, i.e. 14976 s = 4.16x the 3600 s hard cap. Plain random best-of-2 is a REGRESSION (-0.013893 pp) because the canonical labelling sits at z = +1.029. (3) MATCHED COMPUTE, the item's own kill condition: the same doubling spent on refinement at one labelling buys +0.006275 pp (measured off proto_H42.json's 143-cycle curve), ~18x more. On mouse the current champion H52 is EXACTLY relabelling-invariant - 41 fresh labellings at an independent permutation base, one distinct value, span 0.0 pp - so there is nothing to harvest there at any R. Note H01's revival condition ('std >> 0.02 pp') was NOT met by the measured 0.019124 pp; the novelty gate let H56 through on the mechanism difference (full-cost arms vs H01's budget-split arms) and the prototype then vindicated H01's threshold to within 6%. HONEST WEAKNESS, recorded rather than buried: sigma is a 5-point estimate with a 95% chi-squared interval of [0.011458, 0.054955] pp, and grounds (2) and (3) both scale with it - at the UPPER end the anchored best-of-2 gain would be +0.013473 pp, which clears the bar and beats the control. Ground (1), the microns runtime, is arithmetic and does not flip, and it carries the kill on its own.
killed.revival_if: Only via a design that changes the ARITHMETIC, not the framing. Either (a) the per-arm cost drops enough that R_feasible * a_R clears M9 - which is exactly queue item H57, prefix-shared tail multi-start, where sharing the greedy+Rocket+sift prefix makes R = 4 affordable and drops the required sigma to 0.011657 pp; or (b) a mechanism is shown to WIDEN the labelling sigma past 0.021269 pp at the champion's current per-run cost; or (c) the labelling sigma is RE-ESTIMATED at n >= 11 (~1.9 h of GPU, the same measurement H58 needs) and its LOWER confidence bound exceeds 0.021269 pp - the n = 5 estimate used here cannot rule that out. Any revival must additionally answer the microns leg, which is independent of sigma: at 3418 s/run against a 3450 s deadline the variant is bit-identical to the champion there, so the best it can ever be is a connectome-only partial promotion. Re-proposing best-of-R over full-cost pipeline runs at the point-estimate sigma is dead.

killed.mechanism: best-of-R over R randomised refinement TAILS (stage 4, alternate_scc_sift) sharing ONE greedy-FAS + Rocket + first-sift prefix; the tails are randomised by node relabelling, an exact isomorphism, so only tie-breaks move
killed.verdict: killed by its own pre-registered prototype gate - FALSIFIED on three grounds
killed.why_dead: The item's open_question_to_settle_first was 'is the sigma in the prefix or the tail?', and the answer is the prefix. (1) EFFECT SIZE: tail-only sigma is 0.003731 pp against an M9 bar of 0.011658 pp (idle, R = 4) / 0.014180 pp (under P07 load, R = 3), short by 3.1x-3.8x. Unlike H56 this does NOT flip at the upper end of sigma's own chi-squared 95% interval: 0.007594 pp still fails the easier bar by 35%, so the kill is secure on the interval and not merely on the point estimate. (2) EXACT ENUMERATION: the canonical arm is the MAXIMUM of all nine measured arms, so the canonical-anchored best-of-R - the only monotone form, per M9 corollary (1) - gains exactly 0.000000 pp at every R and for every subset; plain random best-of-4 is -0.010532 pp, a regression. (3) MATCHED COMPUTE, the item's own kill condition: the same seconds on ONE longer tail buy at least +0.004707 pp (proto_H42.json, 77 -> 143 cycles, measured; longer arms are beyond the measured curve and that figure is a monotone lower bound). VALIDITY: the identity arm reproduced the champion's 84.15409511053134 exactly and the prefix reproduced its stage-3 83.91351804242117, so the study measured the champion's own pipeline. NOTE, correcting this cycle's own sealed pre-registration rather than the item: microns admits R = 3 under prefix-sharing (prefix 3172.3 s, tail 86.0 s), NOT R = 1 - so H56's runtime ground does not carry over and played no part in this kill. The connectome leg fails on its own and a screen requires a delta on both primaries.
killed.revival_if: Not by a cheaper R. M10 makes the whole 'share the prefix, randomise the tail' family dead on arithmetic, so a revival must WIDEN the dispersion rather than buy more draws of it, and must widen it where it lives - in the prefix.
